title.zh: 香菜粽裡面真的有香菜😱
title.en: There's Actually Cilantro INSIDE the Dumpling 😱

caption.zh: 「我以為只是外面這個…」打開粽子發現裡面真的有香菜，表情全崩了😂 你敢吃嗎？
caption.en: "I thought it was just the outside…" They opened the dumpling and found REAL cilantro inside — the reactions are priceless 😂 Would you eat it?

reason: The group's shocked and funny reaction to discovering a cilantro-filled rice dumpling (香菜粽) makes for a highly relatable and entertaining food-reaction clip.

title.en: Who Would Mistake a Raccoon for a Cat?!

caption.zh: 誰比較可能把浣熊當貓帶回家？結果貓過敏的人直接投降😂 這題太荒唐了啦！
caption.en: Which one of them would bring home a raccoon thinking it's a cat? The one with severe cat allergies immediately noped out 😂

reason: The raccoon-mistaken-for-cat question triggers genuine laughter and a funny cat-allergy confession, with both hosts cracking up visibly in the keyframes and chat reacting with 🤣 emojis.

title.zh: 第一次吃減重粽！表情直接崩了😂
title.en: Trying a 'Diet Zongzi' for the First Time — Faces Say It All 😂

caption.zh: 第一次見到減重粽，冰的、沒有餡、沒有調味⋯⋯沾糖吃？表情管理直接失敗哈哈哈 #端午節 #減重粽
caption.en: First time trying a 'diet zongzi' — it's cold, has no filling, and zero flavour. The faces say everything 😂 #zongzi #foodreaction

reason: The group's genuine reactions—curiosity about a 'diet zongzi', the wobbly jelly-like reveal, failed toss attempt, and the priceless 'no flavour' face—create a funny food-reaction arc that chat clearly enjoyed (XDD, 哈哈哈哈, 表情管理, 這表情崩不住阿).

title.zh: 女團排練無聊跳舞被抓包😂
title.en: Girl Group Can't Resist Mirrors During Rehearsal 😂

caption.zh: 排練唱歌太無聊，忍不住在旁邊自己跳起舞來🕺🪞女團看到鏡子的魔力真的無法擋哈哈哈
caption.en: Too bored during rehearsal so she just… started dancing 💀 Girl groups and mirrors are an unstoppable combo 🪞✨

reason: The group hilariously reveals that during concert rehearsals one member got bored and started dancing in front of mirrors, leading to a relatable and funny discussion about girl-group mirror magnetism, with strong chat reactions (7777, 笑死, 發瘋喔).

title.zh: 誰會假哭獲得優勢？😂成員互相爆料
title.en: Who Fake Cries to Win Arguments? Members Call Each Other Out 😂

caption.zh: 這題也太傷人了吧😂 互相爆料環節直接開始，還有人65歲還被要求點兒童餐哈哈哈哈 #真的假的
caption.en: "Who fake cries to get their way?" 😂 The members start calling each other out — plus someone gets told they look young enough to order a kids' meal at 65 lol

reason: A fun group Q&A game where members are asked who fake-cries to gain an advantage, leading to laughter and teasing, with the bonus payoff of the '65-year-old still being carded for a kids' meal' question that gets a great reaction.
